snippet.title: Nature Digital Board Game - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1926610/Nature/

Adapt your species to survive where food is scarce and predators lurk at every turn. Easy to learn, but offering lots of strategic depth, every ecosystem evolves in its own unique way. From the designer of the award-winning Evolution series, Nature is faster, better balanced, and seamlessly expandable.  

Nature offers a full campaign, custom challenges, online matchmaking, and local multiplayer, with two expansions launching day one: 

Flight:  Find freedom by soaring to the skies, where safety and abundance await those gifted with wings. 

Jurassic - Return to an age of giants, where ferocious predators and colossal dinosaurs roam the land. 

Website:
https://www.naturedigitalgame.com/
